current_state: Dormant / never built. Gasum proposed a second receiving (import) terminal in the Pansio district of the Port of Turku (Varsinais-Suomi / Southwest Finland): a max ~30,000 m3 LNG storage tank with a marine jetty and road-tanker loading bays, distinct from its Pori terminal and from the Porvoo/Ingå 'Finngulf' large terminal. A detailed zoning plan for the Pansio LNG terminal area was accepted in June 2013 but was appealed to the Turku Administrative Court, putting the project 'on ice'. No source shows it advancing past that stage; Gasum's operating Finnish terminals today are Pori, Tornio Manga, and the Inkoo FSRU. No post-2016 activity found (only unrelated LNG bunkering began at the Port of Turku in Oct 2024).
missing_threshold_elements: Sponsor, approximate location, and a concrete step (2013 zoning approval) ARE documented, so the §3 add-threshold is technically met. Held to monitor rather than staged as a new_terminal because: (1) the project is a dead ~decade-old proposal with no activity since ~2016 and no citable current status, ShelvedYear, or CancelledYear (staging a new_terminal would require inventing uncited lifecycle values); (2) all evidence is from 2012-2016 trade press, no capacity confirmation beyond '~30,000 m3' storage; (3) GEM already tracks Gasum's contemporaneous Pori, Porvoo/Ingå (Southern Finland), and Rauma proposals, so whether GEM wants this additional dead same-era duplicate is a human-reviewer call.
watch_for: Any revival of the Turku/Pansio import-terminal proposal, a formal Gasum cancellation statement (would let it be added as cancelled with a citable year), or a new sponsor/permit filing at the Port of Turku for a regasification/import terminal (NOT bunkering, which is out of GEM scope).
notes: Confirmed a GENUINE GEM gap, not a dedup of an existing row: GEM 'Southern Finland LNG Terminal' (T100000130442) is at Inga/Joddbole, Uusimaa (the Finngulf large terminal), NOT Turku; Turku is in Varsinais-Suomi. Verified sources (url_verifier PASS): Riviera 30 May 2014 (Pansio/Gasum/Turku); Yle 4 Mar 2014, https://yle.fi/a/3-7118690 (Pansio terminal 'on ice' due to zoning complaints); LNG Industry 4 Mar 2014, https://www.lngindustry.com/liquid-natural-gas/04032014/site_selected_for_lng_import_terminal_243/ ('Gasum is intending to build an additional import terminal in Pansio, Turku'). Small-scale (~30,000 m3) but import/regas, so in scope (only bunkering is excluded). researcher_initials: AI-draft (discovery sweep).
